scope.delivery: Unpublished additive source after 0.0.10; no installed application or device acceptance.
scope.atomicSemantics: Explicit nonempty outer/nested subsets, triplets and finite numeric leaves. Original full parse precedes editing; complete final parse validates camera/light/cross-field rules after merging all requested values. No temporary field-by-field validity requirement.
scope.noOp: Exact original before/after bytes with [] accepted by native and bridge; pure branded proposal gate independently rejects unchanged candidates.
scope.limits: Whole original/final scenes each limited to 128 KiB UTF-8; all existing full scene3d model, object and cross-field constraints inherited.
scope.tokenPreservation: CST leaf edits only net numbers/color string values; fixed logical paths independent of source key order. Unchanged exponent/signed zero/escaped colors, all keys/objects/viewport/name/structure/trivia/BOM/CRLF retained.

freshWasmBuild.buildOwner: Root performed the centralized fresh native/WASM build.

initialAttempts.cause: New fixture assumed sample camera/light endpoints and energy1 rather than actual [9,7,10]/[0,1,0]/energy1.2; escaped energy replacement yielded invalid literal. New fixture now explicitly sets known test environment, author sample unchanged.

New fixture exponent replacement selected earlier light direction token rather than unchanged object token; raw-failure assertion read nested error instead of existing flat errorCode. Fixed new tests only, exact raw path is now selected by test-host CST.
Pre-independent-review passing bridge state; preserved before subsequent key-swap repair.

resolvedFindings.issue: With camera position/target exchanged, a forged receipt could swap string key tokens instead of requested numeric leaf values while final model and token-change count matched.
resolvedFindings.repair: Native-admitted JSON string tokens followed by colon are immutable keys. Exact key/structure inventory plus net value-token changes and complete expected model bind actual numeric/color value slots; no added JS property parser or native ABI.
resolvedFindings.regression: Added semantic-equivalent camera-key swap receipt rejection to NEW bridge test; actual valid edit remains accepted.

boundaries: New operation/probe is additive; existing parse, transforms, objects, 2D, author schema, runtime and backend contracts unchanged.
New support needs old parse probe and own version1 only; absent/version2 environment does not disable available old domains.
No JS semantic bound/cross-field rule copy, YAML, Node, DOM, property-path parser, filesystem, Save, renderer, World command, geometry session or backend execution in the bridge.
Normal source/value/budget errors leave core available; forged successful receipt poisons runtime.
Original source parse errors retain old codes; invalid environment/cross-field candidate uses scene3d_environment_invalid, final growth uses existing scene3d_limit.
Shared regression contains the new bridge cases; result counts from different runs are not added.
